data.name: Soul Nine
data.detailed_description:
Step into Soul Nine, a captivating virtual retreat simulation set on the mystical Isle of Inner Light, designed to foster deep personal growth. This immersive experience introduces you to the Enneagram, an ancient system of nine distinct types, not as a personality test, but as a powerful tool for self-awareness and transformation. Whether you’re a seeker of wisdom, a guardian of harmony, or a leader of strength, Soul Nine mirrors your inner world, helping you uncover hidden strengths and navigate life’s challenges.

Begin your journey by exploring breathtaking holographic landscapes, from serene beaches to glowing auditoriums, guided by wise holographic mentors adorned with blue face paint. Engage with thoughtful questions and tasks that reveal your unique Enneagram type, offering unlimited opportunities to retake the experience and deepen your insights. Reflect at the Reflection Spot with Centering and Hypnotic Meditations, tailored to help you process emotions, ground your thoughts, or release tension, fostering resilience and inner peace.

Soul Nine is crafted for all, with no specific religious affiliation, making it a safe haven for anyone eager to grow. With stunning visuals powered by the Unity Engine and a soothing orchestral soundtrack, this retreat invites you to pause, discover, and evolve at your own pace. Available on PC & Mac in 2025, Soul Nine is your gateway to a more mindful self—dare to find your light.

Notes: The game includes a test (questionnaire) to determine your Enneagram type. With one purchase on Steam the test can be taken as many times as you like. For yourself, your family and/or others.

The time required to complete the questionnaire in detail is about an hour, total gameplay length is about 2 hours.
